articles.summary: Vir Biotechnology, Inc. (Nasdaq: VIR), today announced that Marianne De Backer, M.Sc., Ph.D., MBA, President and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley 24 th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on Monday, September 14 at 7:45 a.m. ET in New York City, New York. A live webcast of the fireside chat will be available at https://investors.vir.bio and will be archived for 30 days. About Vir Biotechnology Vir Biotechnology, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on powering the immune system to transform lives by discovering and developing medicines for serious infectious diseases and cancer. Its clinical-stage portfolio includes programs for chronic hepatitis delta and multiple PRO-XTEN ® dual-masked T-cell engagers across validated targets in solid tumor indications.
